snippet.title: Monika Dreams of Being A Bride (DDLC The Girl With The Bow MOD) FULL
snippet.description:
This DDLC MOD is Doki Doki The Girl With The Bow a DDLC MODS with Monika, Sayori, Natsuki, and Yuri in Doki Doki Literature Club Mods scene. Author's Synopsis: The story behind this one involves me having had nearly lost someone very near and dear to me (thankfully haven't in the end), so I decided to reflect how I felt via the mod format. In practice, the subjects involved in the mod are vague enough (I feel) that you could make it about anyone; perhaps you may even be able to relate to it yourself. I hope you enjoy this little thing, and maybe, just maybe...it's helpful in a way.

Mod Download: https://aa.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/v8c4qr/the_girl_with_the_bow_mod_release/
